title: Deflect
summary: DEFLECT, verb intransitive [Latin To turn or bend.] To turn from or aside; to deviate from a true course or right line; to swerve. The needle deflects from the meridian. DEFLECT, verb transitive To tu

inlines.v: DEFLECT, verb intransitive [Latin To turn or bend.] To turn from or aside; to deviate from a true course or right line; to swerve. The needle deflects from the meridian. DEFLECT, verb transitive To turn aside; to turn or bend from a right line or regular course.
